_comment: Star Arm 102 leader -> Metal Arm v1. direction = sign x scale (elbow maps the leader's ~270 deg onto the follower's 180 deg; gripper widens the leader's ~61 deg of grip onto the jaw range); range_deg = the follower limits, except the gripper stops at 115 deg (the vendor stroke table documents opening to 116.4 deg only). Source: LeRobot RebotArm102LeaderMetalConfig.
